title: 磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合
titleEn: Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 磷酸鐵鋰因為不含鈷鎳、循環壽命長、熱穩定性好，已經成為電網儲能的主流。把單顆 3.2 V 的電芯組成一座數千 MWh 的電站，要經過模組、電池架、貨櫃、功率轉換與升壓變電好幾個層級的整合。加州沙漠中的愛德華茲與桑伯恩光儲電站有三千多 MWh 的儲能，與太陽能共用併網點。課程定量分析電池架的電壓、貨櫃的數量、直流耦合回收的電量與輔助用電。
summaryEn: Lithium iron phosphate, free of cobalt and nickel, long in cycle life and thermally stable, has become the mainstream for grid storage. Turning single 3.2 V cells into a plant of thousands of megawatt-hours takes integration through modules, racks, containers, power conversion and step-up substation. Edwards & Sanborn in the California desert has over three thousand megawatt-hours of storage sharing a grid connection with solar. The course quantifies rack voltage, container count, energy recovered by DC coupling and auxiliary power.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率、能量與時長」與「電芯數量與串並聯」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power, energy and duration" and "Cell count and series-parallel arrangement": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power, energy and duration" is correct?
options: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。
儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。
電池系統的可靠度和單顆電芯一樣高。
optionsEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration.
The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating.
A battery system is as reliable as a single cell.
quiz.explanation: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「功率、能量與時長」如何決定「磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power, energy and duration” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：儲能容量約 3,287 MWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: Storage capacity is about 3,287 MWh
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「功率、能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power, energy and duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 功率、能量與時長
knowledge.text: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
knowledge.textEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 儲能容量約 3,287 MWh
knowledge.textEn: Storage capacity is about 3,287 MWh

quiz.question: 依「功率、能量與時長」的模型 t = E / P，額定功率下的放電時長最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Power, energy and duration", which value is closest to the discharge duration at rated power?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Pb = 800 MW，得 4.11 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 3287 MWh, Pb = 800 MW the result is 4.11 h (discharge duration at rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「功率、能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power, energy and duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Pb = 800 MW，得 4.11 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pb 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with Eb = 3287 MWh, Pb = 800 MW the result is 4.11 h (discharge duration at rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pb by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.74 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 3.74 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4.11 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pb 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4.11 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pb with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Pb = 800 MW，得 4.11 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 3287 MWh, Pb = 800 MW the result is 4.11 h (discharge duration at rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.74 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 3.74 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power, energy and duration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
變流器只是把直流變交流的轉接器，對電網穩定沒有影響。
依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A converter is just a DC-to-AC adapter with no effect on grid stability.

Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「功率、能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power, energy and duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
knowledge.textEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62933 電能儲存系統標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62933 series on electrical energy storage systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「功率、能量與時長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Power, energy and duration" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
電池系統的可靠度和單顆電芯一樣高。
optionsEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A battery system is as reliable as a single cell.
quiz.explanation: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「功率、能量與時長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power, energy and duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 電芯數量與串並聯：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Cell count and series-parallel arrangement: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「電芯數量與串並聯」如何決定「磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cell count and series-parallel arrangement” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電網級儲能由數十萬到上百萬顆電芯組成。電芯先串聯成模組與電池架以達到約 1,000 至 1,500 V 的直流電壓，再把多個電池架並聯到同一台功率轉換系統。電芯數量乘以每顆的失效機率，決定了系統層級必須面對的故障頻率；因此製造一致性、出廠分選與逐顆電壓溫度監測，比單顆電芯的標稱性能更重要。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grid-scale storage contains hundreds of thousands to more than a million cells. Cells are connected in series into modules and racks to reach about 1,000–1,500 V DC, and racks are paralleled onto one power conversion system. Cell count times individual failure probability sets the fault frequency the system must live with, so manufacturing consistency, factory grading and per-cell voltage and temperature monitoring matter more than nominal cell performance. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：搭配直流容量約 875 MW 的太陽能
steps.observationEn: Project file: It is paired with about 875 MW DC of solar
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電池系統的可靠度和單顆電芯一樣高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A battery system is as reliable as a single cell." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: Grid-scale storage contains hundreds of thousands to more than a million cells. Cells are connected in series into modules and racks to reach about 1,000–1,500 V DC, and racks are paralleled onto one power conversion system. Cell count times individual failure probability sets the fault frequency the system must live with, so manufacturing consistency, factory grading and per-cell voltage and temperature monitoring matter more than nominal cell performance.

quiz.question: 依「電芯數量與串並聯」的模型 N = E / (Q·V)，標稱能量所需的電芯數（單顆容量與電壓為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model N = E / (Q·V) for "Cell count and series-parallel arrangement", which value is closest to the cells needed for the nominal energy (representative cell capacity and voltage)?
quiz.explanation: N = E / (Q·V)；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Ah = 280 A·h、Vc = 3.2 V，得 3,668,527 顆（標稱能量所需的電芯數（單顆容量與電壓為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: N = E / (Q·V); with Eb = 3287 MWh, Ah = 280 A·h, Vc = 3.2 V the result is 3,668,527 cells (cells needed for the nominal energy (representative cell capacity and voltage)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 電芯數量與串並聯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cell count and series-parallel arrangement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電芯數量與串並聯」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Cell count and series-parallel arrangement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = E / (Q·V)；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Ah = 280 A·h、Vc = 3.2 V，得 3,668,527 顆（標稱能量所需的電芯數（單顆容量與電壓為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Ah 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: N = E / (Q·V); with Eb = 3287 MWh, Ah = 280 A·h, Vc = 3.2 V the result is 3,668,527 cells (cells needed for the nominal energy (representative cell capacity and voltage)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Ah by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Ah 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,335,024 顆（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Ah by 10% changes the result to 3,335,024 cells (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 3,668,527 顆（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Ah 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 3,668,527 cells (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Ah with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N = E / (Q·V)；代入 Eb = 3287 MWh、Ah = 280 A·h、Vc = 3.2 V，得 3,668,527 顆（標稱能量所需的電芯數（單顆容量與電壓為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: N = E / (Q·V); with Eb = 3287 MWh, Ah = 280 A·h, Vc = 3.2 V the result is 3,668,527 cells (cells needed for the nominal energy (representative cell capacity and voltage)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Ah 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,335,024 顆（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Ah by 10% changes the result to 3,335,024 cells (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電芯數量與串並聯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cell count and series-parallel arrangement"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
進廠驗收抽測電芯容量、內阻與自放電率的分布，並在系統試運轉時檢查每個電池架在滿充與放空時的最大電芯電壓差。
太陽能加上電池，就只有一種接法。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

At incoming inspection sample the distribution of cell capacity, internal resistance and self-discharge, and during commissioning check the maximum cell-voltage spread in every rack at full charge and at empty.
Solar plus battery can be connected in only one way.
quiz.explanation: 進廠驗收抽測電芯容量、內阻與自放電率的分布，並在系統試運轉時檢查每個電池架在滿充與放空時的最大電芯電壓差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At incoming inspection sample the distribution of cell capacity, internal resistance and self-discharge, and during commissioning check the maximum cell-voltage spread in every rack at full charge and at empty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電芯數量與串並聯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cell count and series-parallel arrangement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電芯數量與串並聯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cell count and series-parallel arrangement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 進廠驗收抽測電芯容量、內阻與自放電率的分布，並在系統試運轉時檢查每個電池架在滿充與放空時的最大電芯電壓差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At incoming inspection sample the distribution of cell capacity, internal resistance and self-discharge, and during commissioning check the maximum cell-voltage spread in every rack at full charge and at empty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範要對電芯容量與內阻的離散度設上限，並要求保留每顆電芯的生產批號追溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement specifications should cap the spread of cell capacity and resistance and require production-lot traceability for every cell.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一串中容量最小的電芯最先充滿、最先放空，限制了整串的可用容量；若均衡能力不足，這顆電芯還會被過充或過放而加速劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The lowest-capacity cell in a string fills and empties first, limiting usable capacity of the whole string, and without enough balancing it is overcharged or over-discharged and ages faster. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 進廠驗收抽測電芯容量、內阻與自放電率的分布，並在系統試運轉時檢查每個電池架在滿充與放空時的最大電芯電壓差。

knowledge.textEn: Procurement specifications should cap the spread of cell capacity and resistance and require production-lot traceability for every cell.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：UL 9540 儲能系統與設備／UL 9540A 熱失控延燒試驗方法。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: UL 9540 Energy Storage Systems and Equipment / UL 9540A thermal-runaway fire-propagation test method. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「電芯數量與串並聯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cell count and series-parallel arrangement" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
電池的電壓是固定的，不會隨充放電改變。
同一串中容量最小的電芯最先充滿、最先放空，限制了整串的可用容量；若均衡能力不足，這顆電芯還會被過充或過放而加速劣化。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Battery voltage is fixed and does not change with charge and discharge.
The lowest-capacity cell in a string fills and empties first, limiting usable capacity of the whole string, and without enough balancing it is overcharged or over-discharged and ages faster.
quiz.explanation: 同一串中容量最小的電芯最先充滿、最先放空，限制了整串的可用容量；若均衡能力不足，這顆電芯還會被過充或過放而加速劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The lowest-capacity cell in a string fills and empties first, limiting usable capacity of the whole string, and without enough balancing it is overcharged or over-discharged and ages faster. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電芯數量與串並聯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cell count and series-parallel arrangement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電芯數量與串並聯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Cell count and series-parallel arrangement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一串中容量最小的電芯最先充滿、最先放空，限制了整串的可用容量；若均衡能力不足，這顆電芯還會被過充或過放而加速劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「磷酸鐵鋰儲能電站系統整合」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: The lowest-capacity cell in a string fills and empties first, limiting usable capacity of the whole string, and without enough balancing it is overcharged or over-discharged and ages faster. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Lithium Iron Phosphate Storage Plant Integration”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：電芯數量乘以每顆的失效機率，決定了系統層級必須面對的故障頻率；因此製造一致性、出廠分選與逐顆電壓溫度監測，比單顆電芯的標稱性能更重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cell count times individual failure probability sets the fault frequency the system must live with, so manufacturing consistency, factory grading and per-cell voltage and temperature monitoring matter more than nominal cell performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電池系統的可靠度和單顆電芯一樣高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A battery system is as reliable as a single cell." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一串中容量最小的電芯最先充滿、最先放空，限制了整串的可用容量；若均衡能力不足，這顆電芯還會被過充或過放而加速劣化。
knowledge.textEn: The lowest-capacity cell in a string fills and empties first, limiting usable capacity of the whole string, and without enough balancing it is overcharged or over-discharged and ages faster.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
